subject: mRNA-1273 cost-effectiveness analysis
statement: ICER is $6,720 per QALY gained using a 10-year Markov model with 3% discount rate from US payer perspective

subject: COVID-19 disease burden
statement: Annual hospitalizations attributable to COVID-19 are estimated at 325,452, with direct medical costs exceeding $17 billion and indirect costs including productivity losses of an estimated $23 billion annually
supporting_quote: Annual hospitalizations attributable to COVID-19 are estimated at 325,452, with direct medical costs exceeding $17 billion. Indirect costs including productivity losses add an estimated $23 billion annually.

subject: mRNA-1273 budget impact analysis
statement: For a plan size of 1,000,000 covered lives with 53% vaccination rate: Year 1 net budget impact is $5M increase, Year 3 cumulative offset is $15M in avoided hospitalizations, and 5-year net savings is $32M
supporting_quote:
Plan Size Modeled: 1,000,000 covered lives
Vaccination Rate Assumed: 53%
Year 1 Net Budget Impact: $5M increase
Year 3 Cumulative Offset: $15M in avoided hospitalizations
5-Year Net Savings: $32M

subject: mRNA-1273 formulary recommendation
statement: Moderna, Inc. recommends preferred formulary placement with no prior authorization restrictions
